question: Which of the following sentences is correct? [Fisheries & Animal-26]
options: The speaker made the audience to listen to him
The speaker made the audience listen to him
The speaker made the audiences to listen to him
The speaker made the audience listening to him
explanation: এখানে Made একটি Causative Verb-যেটি অন্য Person দ্বারা কাজ সম্পন্ন করায়। আবার Made এর পরে infinitive বা base form of verb বসে। Structure-টি হবে Sub + Verb + Object + are infinitive (Verb-এর base form) + others. সুতরাং, সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে– The speaker made the audience listen to him.

question: Which word of the following sentence must be changed to make the sentence correct? The value of the dollar declines as the rate of inflation raises. [Fisheries & Animal-26]
options: value
declines
as
raises
explanation: এখানে 'inflation raises' না হয়ে 'inflation rises' হবে। সুতরাং, 'raises' শব্দের পরিবর্তে 'rises' ব্যবহার করলে বাক্যটি সঠিক হবে।

question: Which one is correct? [BCIC-25]
options: esential
essential
essensial
essencial
explanation:
এখানে,
esential — কোনো অর্থ নেই
essential — প্রয়োজনীয়
essensial — কোনো অর্থ নেই
essencial — কোনো অর্থ নেই ।
সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর হবে essential ।

question: Identify the correct sentence : [GDA-25]
options: They will hold a metting after a week.
They will hold a meeting in a week.
They held a meeting in a week.
They will be holding a meeting after a week.
explanation: এখানে সঠিক বাক্যটি হলো They will hold a meeting in a week. কারণ in a meeting = এক সপ্তাহ পর; 'will + hold' সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

question: Identify the correct sentence : [DPDC-25]
options: She is the person with who I spoke yesterday.
She is the person whom I spoke yesterday.
She is the person to whom I spoke yesterday.
She is the person to who I spoke yesterday.
explanation: এখানে, She is the person to whom I spoke yesterday বাক্যটি সঠিক কারণ এটি "Whom I speak to" Structure অনুসৃত।

question: Which one is correct? [SGCL-2023]
options: Would you mind to close the door?
Would you mind in to close the door?
Would you mind for closing the door
Would you mind closing the door?
explanation: 'Would you mind' phrase-এর পরে verb-এর ing form হয়। সুতরাং Would you mind closing the door? সঠিক বাক্য।

question: Which one is correct? [SGCL-2023]
options: Each boy and each girl have a pen
Each boy and each girl are having a pen
Each boy and each girl has a pen
Each boy and each girl were having a pen
explanation: each boy and each girl দ্বারা singular subject বুঝায়। সুতরাং verb singular হবে। তাই 'Each boy and each girl has a pen' সঠিক বাক্য।

question: Which one is correct? [MOE-2023]
options: The captain commanded the soldiers to fire on.
The Captain told the soldiers to fire on.
The captain proposed the soldiers to fire on.
The captain requested the soldiers to fire on.

question: Identify the correct sentence. [MOE-2023]
options: If you had come, I would have helped you.
If you have come, I would have helped you.
If you have had come, I will help you.
If you had come, I would help you.
explanation: 3rd Conditional বাক্যে If clause যদি If + Sub + had + V3 দিয়ে গঠিত হয়, পরের Clause অবশ্যই Sub + would + have + V3 হবে। তাহলে 'If you had come, I would have helped you.'

question: Identify the correct sentence— [BPSC-2023]
options: Why he went to Dhaka?
Why did he go to Dhaka?
Why he went to Dhaka yesterday?
He has gone to Dhaka yesterday.
explanation: প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্যে Wh words/Auxiliary + Sub + Verb + ......? হয়। তাহলে সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে Why did he go to Dhaka?

question: Identify the correct senence : [BSCIC-2023]
options: Gold is most precious metals.
Gold is one of the most precious metal.
Gold is one of the most precious metals.
Gold is precious than most other metals.
explanation: এখানে Superlative degree-তে one of the + superlative + plural noun/Pronoun হবে। সুতরাং Gold is one of the most precious metals সঠিক।

question: Which of the following sentences is correct? [BPSC-2017, DNCC-2022]
options: This is an unique case.
This is unique case.
This is a unique case.
This is the most unique case.
explanation: একটি word-এ vowel থাকা সত্ত্বেও উচ্চারণ you (ইউ) অথবা ওয়া এর মতো হলে an না হয়ে a হয়।

question: Which one is correct? [BPSC-2021]
options: One should do his duty.
One should do their duty.
One should do one’s duty.
One should do her duty.
explanation: Option (গ) সঠিক উত্তর। 'One should do one's duty' বাক্যে 'One এবং One's' হলো Indefinite pronoun. যে Pronoun কোনো নির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে না বুঝিয়ে অনির্দিষ্ট ব্যক্তি বা বস্তুকে বুঝায় তাকে Indefinite pronoun বলে। সুতরাং, 'One should do one's duty' বাক্যটি সঠিক।

question: Find the correct sentence : [PGCB-21]
options: I had known him for a long time
I have known him for a long time
I know him for a long time
I knew him for a long time
explanation: Present perfect tense-এ কর্তার পর have/has ও Verb-এর Past participle হয়। বাক্যের গঠন অনুসারে “I have known him for a long time” বাক্যটি একটি সঠিক বাক্য।

question: Which one is correct? [BPSC-2021]
options: This is a fine poetry.
This is the fine poem.
This is the fine poetry.
This is the fine poem.
explanation: প্রশ্নে প্রদত্ত Option-গুলোর কোনোটিই সঠিক নয়। Option (ক)-এর হওয়া উচিত ছিল “This is a fine poem.”। কারণ Poem দ্বারা কোনো টুকরা literary work-কে বুঝায়, Poetry হলো একটি Art form। Option (খ) এবং (গ)-এ 'the'-এর পরে Adjective-এর Superlative degree হয়, Positive degree নয়। Option (ঘ)-তেও (খ) এবং (গ) এর একই error হয়েছে।

question: Which one is correct? [BPSC-2021]
options: How much late was he?
How much late he was?
How late was he?
How much later he was?
explanation: Option (গ) How late was he? সঠিক উত্তর। কোনো কিছুর extent, বিস্তার বা ব্যাপ্তি অথবা degree (মাত্রা) সম্পর্কে জানতে How + adj./adv. দ্বারা question করতে হয়।

question: Which sentence is correct? [DNCC-2021]
options: The teacher reached the classroom before the students came.
The teacher had reached the classroom before the students came.
The teacher reached the classroom before the students had come.
The teacher came to the classroom before the students come.
explanation: Past perfect tense-এ option- (b)-ই সঠিক উত্তর। দুইটি কাজের মধ্যে যে কাজটি আগে হয়েছিল সেটি Past perfect এবং যে কাজটি পরে হয়েছিল সেটি Past simple হবে।

question: Which sentence is correct? [DNCC-2021]
options: If you do not read properly, you will fail.
If you will not read properly you will fail.
If you do not reads, you fail.
Read properly not to failed.
explanation: গঠন : If + Present + Future। এটি 1st conditional sentence-এর উদাহরণ। If you do not read properly + you will fail. আবার Complex sentence-এর উদাহরণ হিসেবে এটি সঠিক Sentence।

question: Identify the correct sentence : [BPSC-21]
options: He is a miserly
He is miserly man
He is miserly
He is miser
explanation: Miserly হলো একটি Adjective। Adjective-কে বর্ণনা করতে Article-এর দরকার হয় না। সুতরাং, Option (c) সঠিক উত্তর।

question: Which of the following sentences is correct? [KGDCL-2021]
options: Each of the boys is present in the class.
Each of the boy is present in the class.
Each of the boys are present in the class.
Each of the boy were present in the class.
explanation: Subject–verb–agreement অনুসারে “each of the + Plural subject + Singular verb ব্যবহৃত হয়। সুতরাং (ক) সঠিক উত্তর।

question: Which one is correct? [BPSC-2020]
options: He thought that it is raining.
He thought that it will be raining.
He thought that it will rain.
He thought that it would rain.
explanation: কোনো Sentence-এর প্রথম Past tense হলে Sentence-এর পরবর্তী অংশও Past form হয়।

question: Which sentence is correct? [BWDB-2020]
options: This is an unique case
This is a unique case
This is a very unique case
This is the most unique case
explanation: U vowel-এর উচ্চারণ যদি 'ইউ' এর মতো হয় তাহলে তার পূর্বে 'an' না বসে 'a' বসে।

question: Tick the correct sentence. [DWASA-2020]
options: There are many tiger in the Sundarbans.
There are tigers in Sundarban.
Many tigers of Sundarbans.
There are many tigers in the Sundarbans.
explanation: There are + plural subjects (Noun/Pronoun) হয়।

question: Tick the correct sentence. [DWASA-2020]
options: The teacher reached the classroom before the students came.
The teacher had reached the classroom before the students came.
The teacher reached the classroom before the students had come.
The teacher came to the classroom before the students come.
explanation: দুইটি কাজের মধ্যে যে কাজটি আগে হয়েছিল সেটি Past perfect এবং যে কাজটি পরে হয়েছিল সেটি Past simple হবে।

question: Find out the incorrect sentence. [MOCA-2019]
options: See the word in the dictionary.
The rice of Dhaka is better than that of Rajshahi
The patient had died before the doctor came.
Mr Rahman is on the committee.
explanation: See the word in the Dictionary বাক্যটি ভুল। কেননা কোনো তথ্য Dictionary-তে খোঁজার ক্ষেত্রে 'Look up' phrasal verb টি ব্যবহৃত হয়।

question: Which sentence is correct? [LGED-2019]
options: My father informed the police of the matter.
My father informed of the matter to the police.
I knew the police of the matter.
My father informed the matter to the police.
explanation: Inform somebody of something অর্থ কাউকে কোনো কিছু জানানো।

question: Identify the correct sentence : [HED-2019]
options: It is raining for two days
It rained for two days
It has been raining for two days
It was raining for two days
explanation: কোনো sentence-এর মধ্যে for + অনির্দিষ্ট সময় উল্লেখ থাকলে sentence-টি present perfect continuous tense হয়।

question: Identify the correct sentence. [MOEF-2019]
options: He does not know the alphabets
He has returned yesterday
It is a true fact
They left the room one by one
explanation: They left the room one by one- 'তারা এক এক করে কক্ষ ত্যাগ করলেন'। বাক্যটি সঠিক। বাকি অপশনগুলো সঠিক নয়।

question: Which one is correct? [TTC-2018]
options: The old man was died yesterday.
The old man had died yesterday.
The old man has died yesterday.
The old man died yesterday.
explanation: কোনো Sentence-এ Yesterday, ago থাকলে Verb-টি Past form হয়।

question: Which one is correct? [PWD-2018]
options: One of my sisters are a nurse
One of my sister is a nurse
One of my sisters is a nurse
One of my sister are a nurse
explanation: One of + plural noun + verb (Singular)। সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

question: Which of the following sentences is correct– [BPSC-2017]
options: It is a must.
It is the must.
It is must.
It is an must.
explanation: অত্যাবশ্যক দ্রব্য বা বিষয় অথবা যে জিনিস কিছুতেই হারানো উচিত নয় এমন অর্থে 'a must' হয়।

question: Which of the following is an incorrect sentence? [PWD-2015]
options: I have a bad headache.
He has just come here.
Keep to the left.
I took your leave.
explanation: সঠিক বাক্যটি হবে 'I took leave of you'।

question: Which sentence is correct? [R&H-2012]
options: I lodged a complaint.
I made a complain.
I lodged a complained.
Do not complaint any more.
explanation: Lodge অর্থ দায়ের করা। প্রথম বাক্যটি দ্বারা অভিযোগ দায়ের করা বুঝিয়েছে।

question: Which one is correct? [R&H-2012]
options: It is quarter past ten.
It is a quarter past ten.
It is 15 plus ten.
It is quarter minutes past ten.
explanation: quarter এর পূর্বে Article বসে না।
